# Model comparison

**Status: MEASURED** (real BMAD data, single seed, 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-13). Full tables incl. CIs, brain-ROI, patient-disjoint and slice-stratified variants: `docs/RESULTS.md` (generated by `scripts/summarize_results.py`); raw table: `results/model_comparison.md`.

Test split (once per model), image AUROC / pixel AUROC full-frame / pixel AUROC brain-ROI / AUPRO full-ROI: autoencoder 0.254 / 0.854 / 0.497 / 0.592-0.210; PaDiM (paper default) 0.754 / 0.960 / 0.868 / 0.782-0.476; **PatchCore 0.909 [0.884, 0.931] / 0.979 / 0.922 / 0.847-0.583**. Selected on validation by the rule below: PatchCore. Caveats: single seed; full-frame pixel metrics are inflated by background; the autoencoder's image scores are inverted (specificity 0.000 at its frozen threshold).

Selection rule (code: `pipeline.select_model`, validation metrics only): (1) gates - finite metrics, peak VRAM ≤ 6 GB, latency ≤ 1000 ms; (2) keep runs within 0.02 AUPRO of the best; (3) among them best mean rank of pixel AUROC, per-image Dice, image AUROC; ties → lower latency. Test is evaluated once, after selection.

Fair-comparison controls enforced in code: same splits/preprocessing/evaluation function; thresholds frozen from `valid` (`threshold.json`, refuses `test`); test blocked until thresholds exist and after first use (`evaluations.jsonl`).
